column1: # `branch` is the branch the temp repo is checked out on for that case.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# A few cases prefix one or more env vars (GIT_GUARD_*=…) on the command; run.sh
# strips and exports every leading VAR=val so the dev script sees them.
# `ask` = exit 0 plus a permissionDecision:"ask" object on stdout.
# --- BLOCK: local write while ON a protected branch -------------------------
# --- BLOCK: push whose target resolves to a protected branch ----------------
# --- BLOCK: branch force ops onto a protected branch ------------------------

column4: rtk proxy git push origin main

column1: # --- BLOCK: compound commands (split on shell separators) -------------------

column4: git add . && git push origin main

column1: # --- BLOCK: block-all-push toggle (env var set for this case) ----------------
# --- ALLOW: read-only / non-mutating on protected branch --------------------
# --- ALLOW: regression-locks (deliberately hidden git is out of scope) ------

column4: sudo -u alice git push origin main

column1: # --- ALLOW: disable toggle (env var set for this case) ----------------------
# --- BLOCK: `am` completes the on-branch write verb list (default channel) ---
# --- ASK: every on-branch write verb, with the channel opted in -------------
# --- BLOCK: the explicit default value behaves exactly like unset ------------
# --- BLOCK: force branch ops are NEVER routed to ask ------------------------
# --- BLOCK: no push arm is ever routed to ask -------------------------------

column4: GIT_GUARD_BLOCK_ALL_PUSH=1 GIT_GUARD_LOCAL_WRITE_CHANNEL=ask git push origin feature/x

column1: # --- BLOCK: a deny in a LATER segment outranks an earlier recorded ask -------

column4: GIT_GUARD_LOCAL_WRITE_CHANNEL=ask git commit -m x && git push origin main
GIT_GUARD_LOCAL_WRITE_CHANNEL=ask git commit -m x && git branch -f master other

column1: # --- ASK: two ask-class segments still emit exactly ONE decision object ------

column4: GIT_GUARD_LOCAL_WRITE_CHANNEL=ask git commit -m x && git commit -m y

column1: # --- BLOCK: an unrecognised value FAILS CLOSED to deny ----------------------
# --- ALLOW: ordinary work is untouched by the channel setting ---------------
